desc: Read input $N, K$ and arrays $A, B, C$. Sort them in descending order. Calculate $M = \lceil K^{1/3} \rceil$ (capped at $N$). Extract the top $M$ elements from each array. Generate all $M^3$ values of $A_iB_j + B_jC_k + C_kA_i$. Sort these values descending and print the $K$-th one (index $K-1$).
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Sample 1: N=2, K=5. M=2. Top 2 of each. 8 values. 5th largest should be 31.
Sample 2: N=3, K=10. M=3. Top 3 of each. 27 values. 10th largest should be 30000.
Sample 3: Large inputs. Verify output matches.
